statements.section: Loom initial release: engineering guidance, composed workspaces and operational interfaces
statements.quote: It specifies required behavior; it does not assert that the behavior has already been implemented or qualified.
Deliver this specification together with all retained capabilities in [LoomEnhancements.md](LoomEnhancements.md).

Dependency versions follow their actual toolchains and lockfiles.
Adopting systems retain their own release and contract versions.
